senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (चषति)
To kill or hurt.
(चषति-ते)
To eat.

m. (-षः)
1 The blue jay, (Coracias Indica.)
2 A kingfisher, (according to some.)
E.
चष to injure, (fish, &c.) affix घञ्; also चास.

m. (-सः)
1 The blue jay.
2 Sugar cane: see the preceding.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A vessel for drinking spirits with, a wine glass, &c.
2 Any drinking vessel.
3 Spirituous liquor.
4 Honey.
E.
चष to eat, क्वुन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तिः)
Decay, infirmity.
E.
कृष to plough, ति Uṇādi affix, and च substituted for the radical initials.

m. (-लः)
1 A wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post.
2 An iron ring at the base of the post.
3 A hive.
E.
चष to eat, &c. आलच् Uṇādi aff.
